description: Issue #35 stage 1, V1 gate: CVTRPGSRC-convert the three legacy RPG III programs (JU0300, ZA0500, TK0100) into QRPGLE112 and CRTBNDRPG them under scratch names (LGC0300/LGC0500/LGC0100, so the real RPG III programs are not overwritten). Records conversion messages (job log) and the full converted text (VFYSRC), plus the compile event file (EVFEVENT) for severity/RNF ids.

steps.label: CHGTYP1
steps.cmd: CHGPFM FILE(&LIB/QRPGSRC) MBR(LGJU0300) SRCTYPE(RPG)

steps.label: CHGTYP2
steps.cmd: CHGPFM FILE(&LIB/QRPGSRC) MBR(LGZA0500) SRCTYPE(RPG)

steps.label: CHGTYP3
steps.cmd: CHGPFM FILE(&LIB/QRPGSRC) MBR(LGTK0100) SRCTYPE(RPG)

steps.label: VSRCPF
steps.cmd:
CHKOBJ OBJ(&LIB/QRPGLE112) OBJTYPE(*FILE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF9801) EXEC(CRTSRCPF FILE(&LIB/QRPGLE112) RCDLEN(112) TEXT('CVTRPGSRC target'))

steps.label: RM1
steps.cmd: RMVM FILE(&LIB/QRPGLE112) MBR(LGJU0300)

steps.label: RM2
steps.cmd: RMVM FILE(&LIB/QRPGLE112) MBR(LGZA0500)

steps.label: RM3
steps.cmd: RMVM FILE(&LIB/QRPGLE112) MBR(LGTK0100)

steps.label: CVT1
steps.cmd: CVTRPGSRC FROMFILE(&LIB/QRPGSRC) FROMMBR(LGJU0300) TOFILE(&LIB/QRPGLE112) TOMBR(LGJU0300) CVTRPT(*YES) LOGFILE(*NONE)

steps.label: CVT2
steps.cmd: CVTRPGSRC FROMFILE(&LIB/QRPGSRC) FROMMBR(LGZA0500) TOFILE(&LIB/QRPGLE112) TOMBR(LGZA0500) CVTRPT(*YES) LOGFILE(*NONE)

steps.label: CVT3
steps.cmd: CVTRPGSRC FROMFILE(&LIB/QRPGSRC) FROMMBR(LGTK0100) TOFILE(&LIB/QRPGLE112) TOMBR(LGTK0100) CVTRPT(*YES) LOGFILE(*NONE)

steps.label: CRTEVF
steps.cmd:
CHKOBJ OBJ(&LIB/VFYEVF) OBJTYPE(*FILE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF9801) EXEC(CRTPF FILE(&LIB/VFYEVF) RCDLEN(300) TEXT('compile event capture'))

steps.label: CLREVF
steps.cmd: CLRPFM FILE(&LIB/VFYEVF)

steps.label: CMP1
steps.cmd: CRTBNDRPG PGM(&LIB/LGC0300) SRCFILE(&LIB/QRPGLE112) SRCMBR(LGJU0300) OPTION(*EVENTF) REPLACE(*YES)

steps.label: EVF1
steps.cmd: CPYF FROMFILE(QTEMP/EVFEVENT) FROMMBR(LGJU0300) TOFILE(&LIB/VFYEVF) MBROPT(*ADD) FMTOPT(*NOCHK)

steps.label: CMP2
steps.cmd: CRTBNDRPG PGM(&LIB/LGC0500) SRCFILE(&LIB/QRPGLE112) SRCMBR(LGZA0500) OPTION(*EVENTF) REPLACE(*YES)

steps.label: EVF2
steps.cmd: CPYF FROMFILE(QTEMP/EVFEVENT) FROMMBR(LGZA0500) TOFILE(&LIB/VFYEVF) MBROPT(*ADD) FMTOPT(*NOCHK)

steps.label: CMP3
steps.cmd: CRTBNDRPG PGM(&LIB/LGC0100) SRCFILE(&LIB/QRPGLE112) SRCMBR(LGTK0100) OPTION(*EVENTF) REPLACE(*YES)

steps.label: EVF3
steps.cmd: CPYF FROMFILE(QTEMP/EVFEVENT) FROMMBR(LGTK0100) TOFILE(&LIB/VFYEVF) MBROPT(*ADD) FMTOPT(*NOCHK)

steps.label: VSRCTXT
steps.cmd:
CHKOBJ OBJ(&LIB/VFYSRC) OBJTYPE(*FILE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF9801) EXEC(CRTSRCPF FILE(&LIB/VFYSRC) RCDLEN(112) TEXT('converted text capture'))

steps.label: CLRSRC
steps.cmd: CLRPFM FILE(&LIB/VFYSRC) MBR(*ALL)

steps.label: CPY1
steps.cmd: CPYF FROMFILE(&LIB/QRPGLE112) FROMMBR(LGJU0300) TOFILE(&LIB/VFYSRC) TOMBR(LGJU0300) MBROPT(*REPLACE) CRTFILE(*NO)

steps.label: CPY2
steps.cmd: CPYF FROMFILE(&LIB/QRPGLE112) FROMMBR(LGZA0500) TOFILE(&LIB/VFYSRC) TOMBR(LGZA0500) MBROPT(*REPLACE) CRTFILE(*NO)

steps.label: CPY3
steps.cmd: CPYF FROMFILE(&LIB/QRPGLE112) FROMMBR(LGTK0100) TOFILE(&LIB/VFYSRC) TOMBR(LGTK0100) MBROPT(*REPLACE) CRTFILE(*NO)

steps.sql: SELECT TABLE_PARTITION, SRCSEQ, SRCDTA FROM &LIB/VFYSRC ORDER BY TABLE_PARTITION, SRCSEQ
